_comment: Per-checkpoint architecture facts, keyed by the Hugging Face repo of the open weights. Config-derived fields are written by `node scripts/arch-sync.mjs extract`; fields listed in an entry's `manual` are hand-verified from the model card (sources) and never overwritten. `node scripts/arch-sync.mjs build` derives the serving fields into src/sim/roster.arch.generated.ts. `aa` lists the Artificial Analysis rows (slug → UUID) that measure this checkpoint — the open-weight evidence gen-roster joins on.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B.notes: A Qwen3-8B (dense GQA) distilled from DeepSeek-R1-0528 — not a DeepSeek MLA architecture.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731.notes: Same V4 compressed-attention layout as V4-Pro: 2 SWA-only + 21 CSA + 20 HCA layers.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813.notes: CSA (ratio 4) + HCA (ratio 128) compressed attention with one shared 512-d KV head and a 128-token window; FP4 experts + FP8.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.notes: Causal encoder–decoder with Compressed Sparse Attention 2: the card publishes 890 bytes/token with FP4 KV (≈1.7K elements), used directly; 128-token window on every layer. 763B total includes 196B Engram memory.

google/gemma-4-E2B-it.notes: Card: 2.3B effective (5.1B with per-layer embeddings); the last 20 layers reuse KV.

google/gemma-4-E4B-it.notes: Card: 4.5B effective (8B with per-layer embeddings); the last 18 layers reuse KV.

IFM/K2-Horizon-0.9B.notes: Thinking: card: reasoning effort set per request.

IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B.notes: Fully open; 5.06B including the untied embedding. Thinking: card: reasoning effort set per request.

IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B.notes: Plain full-attention GQA at 375B (244 KB/token). Thinking: card: reasoning effort set per request.

IFM/K2-Horizon-7B.notes: Fully open (weights, data, code); 9.0B including the untied 250K-vocab embedding. Thinking: card: reasoning effort set per request (high recommended).

IFM/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B.notes: Mixture-of-Values attention: routed V experts, but the cache stores standard 8×128 K/V. Thinking: card: reasoning effort set per request.

inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash.notes: 35 KDA + 7 gated MLA layers (5:1). Thinking: card: thinking model.

inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash.notes: 63 KDA + 9 gated MLA layers (7:1); FP8 release. README advertises 1M context; config serves 262K.

LiquidAI/LFM2-24B-A2B.notes: Card: 24B total / 2.3B active; context length 32,768 tokens.

LiquidAI/LFM2-8B-A1B.notes: Card: 8.3B total / 1.5B active; context length 32,768 tokens.

LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Thinking.notes: Card: context length 32,768 tokens (config max_position_embeddings 128,000 is the architectural cap).

meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.0.notes: Two MLA sublayers per shortcut-connected block + LongCat sparse-attention indexer keys; zero-compute experts.

meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B.notes: config.json is gated (manual approval); layout from the HF blog + card: 62 full GQA layers, 16 KV heads × 64 — the blog's 266 GB at 1M tokens matches exactly.

MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M1-80k.notes: Card: 1M-token input context (config max_position_embeddings 10,240,000 is a RoPE setting, not the trained window). Thinking: card: a hybrid-attention reasoning model (80K thinking budget).

MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.notes: Card: an interleaved thinking model; full GQA attention (not MLA); FP8 release.

MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7.notes: Full GQA attention (not MLA); FP8 release.

MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.notes: GQA + MiniMax Sparse Attention: the sparse index keys are excluded, so the KV figure is a lower bound.

moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking.notes: Card: native INT4 quantization-aware training — benchmarks are measured at INT4.

moonshotai/Kimi-K3.notes: 69 Kimi Delta Attention + 24 gated MLA layers; MXFP4 QAT weights (1.56 TB). Licence: separate agreement for MaaS above $20M revenue.

Motif-Technologies/Motif-3.notes: Grouped differential attention on an MLA latent: 14 global + 39 sliding-window (128) layers. Thinking: card: reasoning model.

nex-agi/Nex-N2-Pro.notes: An agentic post-train of Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (same layout). Thinking: card: thinking model (Qwen3.5-397B base).

nvidia/Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B.notes: Same NemotronH layout as Nemotron 3 Nano 30B; card: thinking by default.

nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-.notes: Thinking: card: reasoning model (NemotronH Omni Reasoning).

nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B.notes: Same NemotronH 30B-A3B layout and parameter count as Nemotron 3 Nano 30B (3.2B active excluding embeddings).

openai/gpt-oss-120b.notes: MoE weights post-trained in MXFP4; card: runs on a single 80 GB GPU.

openai/gpt-oss-20b.notes: MoE weights in MXFP4; card: runs within 16 GB of memory.

openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B.notes: Hybrid thinking via enable_thinking; 2 KV heads. Thinking: card: hybrid thinking (enable_thinking).

Qwen/Qwen3-8B.notes: Card: 32,768 native context (131,072 with YaRN); config max_position_embeddings 40,960 includes generation headroom.

Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.notes: 48 Gated DeltaNet + 16 gated full-attention layers (the Qwen3.6-27B layout).

Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.notes: 36 Gated DeltaNet + 12 sparse full-attention layers; 180B total includes a 51B n-gram embedding table.

stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview.notes: 69 sliding-window (512) + 23 full sparse-GQA layers (sparse-indexer keys not counted); FP8 release.

tencent/Hy3.notes: Plain full-attention GQA — the high-KV foil for the 2026 hybrids.

thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small.notes: 35 sliding-window (512) + 7 global GQA layers; short convs in every block; card: 1M context (model_max_length 1,048,576).

upstage/Solar-Open2-250B.notes: 12 NoPE GQA + 36 KDA linear layers; card: only 12 of 48 layers keep a KV cache. Thinking: card: reasoning model.

XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD.notes: 39 sliding-window (128) + 9 global GQA layers; FP8 with MXFP4-stored experts.

XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD.notes: 60 sliding-window (128) + 10 global GQA layers; K 192 / V 128 head dims; FP8 with MXFP4-stored experts.

zai-org/GLM-5.2.notes: MLA (kv_lora 512 + rope 64) on all 78 layers + DSA lightning-indexer keys on the 21 full-indexer layers.

zai-org/GLM-5.3.notes: Same 753B/40B MLA + DSA layout as GLM-5.2; FP8 release.

zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash.notes: 34 KDA + 11 DSA/MLA layers (no RoPE dims); indexer keys on all 45 layers — matches Z.ai's 4.4× smaller KV than GLM-5.3 within 5%.
